pins.why: The extractor assigned a grey band (#dddddd) as the surface; the page background is white, and #ffffff is in the site own palette pool. Text on #dddddd measured 3.30:1.
The extracted text colour #777777 fails AA against the real surface (3.30:1). #2a2a2a is in the site own pool and measures 14.35:1 on white.
Input borders need 3:1 (non-text contrast). The extracted #ebebeb measured 1.14:1; #767676 measures 4.54:1.
The coral accent #fe6c61 with the template default white ink measures 2.79:1; #2a2a2a ink measures 5.15:1.
Measured from the live nav links: 12px / 600 / uppercase / 0.26px tracking.
